other_conditions: Both father's and mother's income from all sources must be derived from Border Area
Individuals employed in government service are not eligible for the scholarship
Ph.D. and M.Phil students are not entitled to the scholarship
Only B.Ed and M.Ed students who are currently pursuing the course and are not already in service are eligible
The applicant's village must be listed among the notified border‑area villages issued by the Border Area Department
Participation in any government political activities or demonstrations will result in loss of the scholarship
The scholarship is contingent on good conduct, regular attendance and satisfactory academic progress
If the scholar leaves the course before completion, the scholarship will be suspended
The scholarship holder may receive other scholarships in addition to this grant/subsidy
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided to eligible B.Ed and M.Ed students from notified border‑area villages.
